editorial:
Imagine finding out your parents are splitting up and deciding that you are the only ones who can fix it. That is exactly what happens here, where three siblings team up to save their family from a divorce. They end up hiring a wild and quirky personal injury lawyer to help them play matchmaker for their own parents. The whole vibe is lighthearted and sweet, making it the kind of movie you can just lean back and enjoy without any stress. It captures that funny yet desperate feeling of kids trying to handle adult problems with a plan that is way too chaotic to actually work.

What really makes this work is the chemistry between the kids and the eccentric lawyer, who adds a lot of laughs to the mix. While the plot is a bit predictable, the pacing stays snappy and the acting feels natural. If you are looking for a cozy night in, you should definitely check this out. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture, or you might want to rent it on Apple TV if you just want a quick watch. It is a perfect pick for a family movie night where you want something wholesome.
endingExplained: After all the funny schemes and chaotic dates, the parents finally realize they still love each other. The kids' plan actually works because it forces the parents to remember why they fell in love in the first place. Instead of signing the divorce papers, they decide to go to therapy and work on their marriage. The movie ends on a happy note with the family staying together and the kids celebrating their big win.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves wholesome family comedies with a bit of humor.
